description: Loan offers of Romanian banks, from Agregator.ro, updated daily: personal (nevoi personale), mortgage (imobiliar), refinancing, Noua Casă and car loans. Ranked by estimated total cost for the amount and term, with the rate, rate type, the bank's representative example (DAE), the estimated monthly payment and the current IRCC, ROBOR and EURIBOR. In Romanian.

amount.description: Amount to borrow. Default: 50000 personal, 300000 mortgage/Noua Casă, 250000 refinance, 80000 auto.

bank.description: Only this bank, by name or short name, e.g. "BCR", "Banca Transilvania", "ING".

type.description: personal, mortgage, refinance, nouaCasa or auto. Default personal.

years.description: Term in years. Default 5 (personal, auto), 25 (refinance), 30 (mortgage, Noua Casă).
